content: {"episode_id":"ep-05054","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 for missing prior authorization based on the documented clinical indication. The patient has recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness prompting evaluation for underlying cardiac arrhythmia, with a known history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction. In the setting of concurrent nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency, the clinical indication note states that continuous ambulatory monitoring is indicated to characterize the rhythm disturbance and assess for potential embolic risk factors."}
